newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian bourse gets glassfibre firm as new stock.
newsitem.headline: Latvian bourse gets glassfibre firm as new stock.

text.p: The Latvian stock exchange is to get a major new share listing as the Valmiera Glassfibre company is to join the bourse on February 24, the bourse said on Thursday.
The company will have 11.5 million shares listed with a nominal value of one lat each, the stock exchange said in a statement. It will join the secondary bourse list.
Germany's Glasseiden Oschatz has a 49 percent stake in Valmiera Glassfibre, which made a 235,736 lat 1996 profit and had assets of 14.08 million lats.
Some 23.91 percent of the company was also sold in a public offer while 22 percent is owned by workers and former workers.
